bull.narrative: Gold and silver prices surge above $4,000/oz driven by de-dollarisation and central bank buying. Franco-Nevada's royalty pipeline matures with Cobre Panama resuming and new additions. 10yr revenue CAGR of 12%.

base.narrative: Gold holds $2,500-$3,000/oz. Royalty portfolio grows organically at 7% annually. Cobre Panama remains suspended but pipeline adds 3-4 new streams per year.

bear.narrative: Gold retreats to $1,500/oz on strong USD and rising real rates. Royalty model faces write-downs. Revenue stagnates. Multiple compression to 15x earnings.

tracking_note: Gold at $3,200/oz, royalty portfolio intact, Cobre Panama suspended but optionality preserved. Base case trajectory.
thesis_breaks_if: Gold falls below $1,800/oz for 24+ months AND Cobre Panama is permanently abandoned
